passages.title: Harry’s Story
text: First, Ms. Jones spoke with Harry, the oldest son.
“Someone ate your mom’s cake. What did you do this morning?”
“I played soccer, and I came back home around 11. I saw the box on the table and opened it. There was a cake inside, but I didn’t eat it.”
“Hmm.... Then why do you have crumbs around your mouth?”
“Oh, I ate some chocolate cookies because I was hungry.”
koreanText: 처음에, Ms. Jones는 큰 아들 Harry와 이야기했다.
“누군가 너희 엄마의 케이크를 먹었어. 오늘 아침에 너는 무엇을 했니?”
“저는 축구를 했고, 11시쯤 집에 돌아왔어요. 저는 식탁 위에 있는 상자를 보았고 그것을 열었어요. 안에 케이크가 있었지만, 저는 그것을 먹지 않았어요.”
“흠…. 그러면 네 입 주변에 왜 부스러기가 있지?”
“오, 저는 배가 고파서 초콜릿 쿠키를 조금 먹었어요.”
